parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented trans prosecution, no gender-marker, facility or custody rule, and no evidence of police targeting of trans people — so the highest tiers of exposure (universal state-imposed restrictions, organised targeting) are not documented. The worst documented feature is tier-3: societal hostility toward gender-nonconformity (slurs against effeminate men, a dated killing of a man read as gay, an evangelical campaign against gay tourists) combined with thin recourse — police documented as dismissing and ridiculing anti-LGBT victims, with no anti-discrimination or hate-crime protection. The 2024 reading-down of the sexual offences provisions is a positive rule-of-law signal but touches conduct only. Extrapolating from the absence of any protective infrastructure for gender identity and an unresolved hostility record, the traveller outed faces real discrimination and unreliable protection, though not state persecution.
